runtimeSettings.title: Settings-ka Wakhtiga Socodka
runtimeSettings.description: Hagaaji sida Novera uu u maareeyo oo uu u tijaabiyo mar kale server-yada MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeout: Waqtiga ugu badan ee wacista qalabka (ilbiriqsiyo)
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Waqtiga ugu badan ee lagu sugayo jawaabta qalabka MCP ka hor intaanu dhaafin waqtiga.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputChars: Xarfaha ugu badan ee natiijada qalabka
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Natiijada qalabka ee ugu dheer ee lagu hayo wadahadalka. Wax kasta oo ka dambeeya waxaa la jarayaa oo loo calaamadeeyaa in la gooyay, si hal natiijo weyn aysan u buuxin karin macnaha model-ka. U dejiso 0 si natiijooyinka loo hayo dhammeystiran.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRouting: Qalabka caqliga leh ee MCP ee la marsiiyo
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Marka la hawlgaliyo, Novera wuxuu doortaa server-yada MCP ee khuseeya ka hor inta aanala soo rarin qalabka. Jooji si mar kasta loogu raro liiska buuxa ee qalabka MCP.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Isticmaal moodel gaar ah oo loogu talagalay marsiinta
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Marka smart routing uu shidanyahay, ku socodsii talaabada routing model gaar ah (inta badan mid yar) halkii aad ka isticmaali lahayd chat model-ka. Dami si mar walba loogu isticmaalo chat model-ka firfircoon ee routing.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Dooro bixiyaha iyo model-ka hal meel. Kaliya models fudud ayaa liiska ku jira si routing-ku u ahaado degdeg oo jaban.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Ma jiraan models fudud oo la heli karo. Ku dar model yar ama habee API furayaasha ee Models.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptySearch: Ma jiraan wax la mid ah “{{query}}”.
